_doc: Print-orientation failure cards for python/failure/aniso.py and prob.py. Fitted by failure.pla_orient (PLA, Weibull) and failure.cicero_orient (ABS, TCD); results in results/failure/. Modes: F filament, T filament bond, L layer bond; a mode absent from a card is off. Plies: [theta, theta - 90] about the build direction from the reference axis (the load axis of the calibration specimens).

pla-as2018-orient.name: PLA, Ahmed & Susmel 2018 process: orientation TCD (line method) and Weibull with gradient support

F.note: not identified by these cross-ply prints (the fit runs to infinity); S0_T x sigma0_F/sigma0_T of the TCD block

scatter.source: replicate log-std 0.0342 (36 dof); bias and tau from the Weibull model's leave-one-family-out residuals

pla-as2018-orient.domain: Flat-printed PLA of the source process, raster labels 0/30/45 read as cross-ply [theta, theta-90]. Notch roots are the drawn arcs (nurb-fea-tcd #74). The Weibull support length l = 6.5 mm is close to the half-ligament (7.5 mm): it absorbs net-section yielding, not a material length. The filament mode F is not identified by the Weibull data (the cross-ply's transverse ply always governs); the TCD block identifies sigma0_F only weakly. No layer-bond (L) data.

tcd.L_source: literature, held (K 3.7 MPa sqrt(m), sigma 42.9 MPa); the plates fail near net section, L is not identified
tcd.parity: isotropic line sigma0 54.81 MPa, point 58.72 MPa vs nurb-fea-tcd 54.97 / 58.53 MPa (same 54 plates, same L)

pla-as2018-orient-demo-L.name: DEMONSTRATION ONLY: pla-as2018-orient plus an assumed layer-bond mode
pla-as2018-orient-demo-L.domain: L assumed: S0_L = 0.55 S0_T (Z about 55 % of X for FDM, a vendor-cited test), shear ratio as T. No notched or unnotched build-tilt data was found for this material; never use for design.

abs-cicero2020-orient.name: ABS, Cicero et al. 2020 SENB: per-mode TCD (point method)
abs-cicero2020-orient.domain: Flat-printed ABS of the Cicero process, layups 0/90, 30/-60, 45/-45, SENB bending. Out of calibration for the Ng-Susmel nominal-tension ABS (about +29 % over-prediction, nurb-fea-tcd 2D study). No Weibull calibration; no layer-bond data. On the Ng & Susmel ABS tension plates (54, 0/30/45 rasters, results/failure/abs_orient.json) this card over-predicts by 42 % on average (0 deg +27 %, 45 deg +55 %): a different process, not a transferable card.

abs-m30-fortus-orient.name: ABS-M30, Stratasys Fortus process: per-mode TCD (point method) with a measured layer-bond mode

scatter.source: Kinski et al. 2023 Table 2: pooled within-cell log-std 0.018 (24 dof) of plain ISO 527 bars; forces recorded in 0.05 kN steps (about 1 %), so a resolution-limited bound, and no model error is known for notched Fortus parts (no notched Fortus data)

sources.in_plane: project card ABS-M30-iso (K 75 MPa sqrt(mm), sigma_0 63 MPa, checked on Cicero SENB -8..+6 %), taken as the filament and transverse strength alike (the raster effect is not resolved)
sources.shear_ratio: Kinski et al. 2023 (doi 10.5604/01.3001.0016.2964) Table 2: flat +-45 / 0-90 = 0.979 -> Y/S12 = 1.78; T-mode bound r >= sqrt(3); one force step either way gives 1.73-1.9; F carries the same in-plane shear strength (X = Y here, so X/S12 = Y/S12); without it a tilted build would load the filament ply in interlaminar shear for free
sources.layer_bond: Kinski et al. 2023 Table 2: upright ZX / flat XY = 0.855 (30.9 / 36.1 MPa), Fortus 400mc, 95 C chamber, 0.254 mm layers; on edge YZ 1.05. Z/S13 taken equal to Y/S12 (not measured)

abs-m30-fortus-orient.domain: Stratasys Fortus ABS-M30 at 100 % infill with one contour. The notch constants are the isotropic ABS-M30-iso card's; the layer-bond ratio and the scatter come from unnotched bars only. Not for the Ng & Susmel or Cicero processes (different strength and scatter). No Weibull block: TCD only.
